root_cause.summary: The production build generated additional final HTML routes after the repository sitemap had been authored, while Netlify did not regenerate sitemap.xml from the final deployable HTML. Functional generated views also inherited the homepage robots meta, so geenIndex did not override index,follow when a robots tag already existed.

prevention.prevention_rule: Generate sitemap.xml from the final production HTML on every deploy, exclude noindex/non-canonical routes, and overwrite inherited robots metadata for explicitly non-indexable generated views.
regression_contract: Netlify build invokes tools/genereer-sitemap.mjs after localized/final route generation.
Generated views with geenIndex always emit noindex, follow even if a robots meta already exists.
Sitemap is derived from canonical final HTML rather than maintained independently.

tests: GitHub build, contract, smoke and CodeQL gates for this delivery candidate.
Netlify deploy preview is used before production promotion.
evidence.production_readback: Pending exact production promotion and live sitemap/readback; terminal evidence is appended to the governed PR after merge.
